question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, and if so should it be default-on or opt-in?
rationale: The feature is source-verifiably missing and feasible inside the plugin, but it changes official memory retrieval semantics, config/defaults, persistent index lifecycle, and fallback policy.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned FTS indexing, explicit hybrid config/default policy, query-text propagation, vector fallback, docs, and tests.

options.title: Keep advanced LanceDB retrieval external
options.body: Leave official memory-lancedb vector-only and direct hybrid/reranker users to an external plugin or ClawHub package.

options.title: Document vector-only by design
options.body: Close the direction after explicitly documenting that memory-lancedb owns vector retrieval while memory-core and QMD own hybrid retrieval.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned FTS indexing, explicit hybrid config/default policy, query-text propagation, vector fallback, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from memory-lancedb history, memory hybrid history, and prior maintainer-side review context on this issue.
